terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: A one-piece moulding: nothing opens, turns or swings, nothing attaches, so one root pivot and zero sockets. Placed by the dozen at every street table, so the single draw call is the design constraint. Every street food table, temple fair and shophouse front; stacked in towers when not in use. Red polypropylene worn pale on the seat, dusty at the feet.

reasoning: ONE closed shell lathe -- underside pan, flared apron, rolled rim and FLAT moulded top in a single profile -- plus ONE thin worn-seat pan and four FULL-HEIGHT tapered leg cylinders whose tops are the stacking pads: one merge on one material, the ONE draw call the small class allows.
One material: red polypropylene as a vertex colour on a WHITE material, the worn seat a second vertex colour, scuffing as one 256 px canvas bound after construction.
No repetition system at one draw call: the four legs are four primitives inside the single merge.
Action readiness: one root pivot, zero sockets, one declared box collider, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The identity is a LOW stool: a flat moulded top inside a fat rolled rim, a flared apron, and four short legs moulded up the side as ribs that bury themselves in the apron flare (v6, owner review: no pads, no top face). The plate centre column puts the top disc minor axis at 430 px against the outer rim 536, so the flat top is 0.82 of the rim radius inside a 22 mm rim ring with a 2.5 mm moulded lip -- v5 (owner review 2026-09-03): the earlier 25 mm dish is gone, the owner reads the plate as a flat moulded top.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

details.description: flat moulded top with a 2.5 mm lip inside a rolled rim
four full-height tapered D-section legs moulded up the apron side to feet at the envelope edge
four leg ribs blending into the apron flare, their tops buried at 0.178 with no pad and no top face (v6)
street dust up the bottom 60 mm of the legs

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 0.34 x 0.20 x 0.34 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=800 triangles, <=1 draw calls, <=1 materials, <=2 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot plus 0 named mechanism pivot(s); zero sockets; box collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

silhouette.description: A 0.335 m disc 0.06 m thick at 0.200 m -- a flared apron under a rolled rim around a 0.226 m FLAT moulded top with a 2.5 mm lip -- on four tapered D-section legs that rise from the feet (0.167 from the axis) up the apron side as ribs and bury their tops inside the flare at 0.178, below the rim, with no pad and no top face (v6). Owner reviews 2026-09-03: seat raised, legs out, handhold patches removed; legs made ONE piece; the top flattened; then v6 -- the legs lowered out of the rim and moulded into the side.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: x and z +-0.166 at the apron, +-0.167 at the splayed feet, +-0.146 at the rim; y 0 to 0.2005 at the leg-top pads, the rim top at 0.199 flush with them. The LIST-TIME declaration of 0.32 x 0.43 x 0.32 was wrong and the previous build inherited it: w/h 0.74 is a BAR stool, and it shipped a thin flat seat on four long posts. Two independent measurements say the prop is squat. The Meshy proxy bbox is 1.899 x 1.135 x 1.900, w/h 1.674. The plate solves to the same family: the seat-top ellipse minor/major gives a camera elevation of 43.4 deg, and the 843 x 881 px silhouette with the near-foot / far-lug depth term (2r sin th = 550 px) removed leaves h 456 px against w 843, w/h 1.85. The declaration is now 0.335 / 0.200 = 1.675, the proxy figure. The vertical split is measured as well: proxy voxel occupancy over a 64 x 48 x 64 grid collapses from 1955 to 310 shell cells at y/H 0.94 (the seat lid ends and the apron ring begins) and from 256 to 121 at y/H 0.76 (the apron ends and four legs remain), so seat+apron is the top 24.5 percent and the legs the bottom 75.5. The plate agrees at 28 percent, its apron front wall measuring 94 px of the solved 456. Built at 30 percent -- apron bottom 0.140 of 0.200 -- the fuller of the two, because the plate shows a rolled band whose bottom curve the proxy 20 mm voxel cannot resolve. Radii follow the proxy rmax/H: rim 0.749 -> 0.150 built 0.146, apron 0.775 -> 0.155 built 0.166, feet 0.829 -> 0.166 built 0.162.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Independent Meshy v7 reconstruction of the same plate: bbox 1.899 x 1.135 x 1.900, w/h 1.674, which is what condemned the previous build. Band table after the rebuild: mean |delta width| 0.0712 and |delta depth| 0.0729 of height, down from 1.018 / 1.017 against the old envelope. Eight of ten bands are inside 0.10. Band 9 remains +0.31 because the proxy fills the seat concavity -- it carries a solid lid where the plate measures a 25 mm recess -- and band 0 is -0.10, the proxy standing its feet 2 percent of height further out than the apron will let a straight leg reach.

viewEvidence.note: NOT DIRECTLY OBSERVED as an elevation. Confidence 0.80: the plate looks down at 43.4 deg, so the apron height and leg length are solved from the centre-column scan (apron front wall 94 px, silhouette 881 px) rather than read off, and cross-checked against the proxy voxel split.

componentTree.name: Moulded stool
componentTree.topologyRationale: One closed shell lathe, one worn-seat pan and four full-height leg cylinders merged into one geometry on one material: one draw call.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: Shell profile 0.000/0.142 -> 0.151/0.140 -> 0.157/0.168 (apron widest) -> 0.137/0.199 (rim outer top) -> 0.115/0.199 (rim ring) -> 0.113/0.1965 (lip) -> 0.000/0.1965 (flat top), at 18 segments. Worn pan 0.110 radius, flat at 0.198, 1.5 mm proud of the top. Legs ONE piece each (v6): 0.178 tall at axis radius 0.142 (foot) to 0.136 (top), radii 0.032 (foot) to 0.018 (top) flattened 0.78 radially, standing ~1 cm proud below the apron edge and tapering into the flare, the top cap 3.5 mm inside the shell (outer edge 0.150 against the shell's 0.1535 at 0.178) so no leg face shows above the apron.
geometryDescriptor.zFightingNote: The worn pan is 1.5 mm PROUD of the flat top, never flush. The leg tops are buried inside the apron flare as interpenetrating solids, below the rim ring, so no two bounding-box faces share a plane. check-coplanar clean at 0.001 m.
geometryDescriptor.mergeNote: One merged BufferGeometry with world UVs at 0.30 m and a world-space y tint for the dust at the feet.

localFeatures.delivery: world-space y tint 0-0.06 multiplied into the red

colorMaterialRecipe.recipe: Red as a vertex colour on a white material with a light streak canvas; worn seat #8f4b3d.

pivot.name: root
pivot.notes: At the origin the asset declares. A STATIC prop: nothing opens, turns or swings, so one root pivot is the whole mechanism inventory and that is the correct answer, not a gap.

collider.notes: Declared on the asset as box: the stool envelope. The shipped compound is DERIVED from the geometry by scripts/derive-colliders.mjs.

roughness.notes: Scalar observed for this surface in the plate. The independently extracted map is kept on disk as evidence and is NOT bound at runtime -- this material is textureless, so the scalar is the runtime value.

albedo.samplingNotes: Measured as the mean of crops/red.png. extract_pbr_evidence confidence 0.840. The extractor palette is advisory only: these crops are flat material swatches, not isolated objects, so its foreground separation is weak by its own warnings. Albedo is the direct crop measurement.

localOverrides.evidence: crops/seat.png -- #c4776d sd 20, pale scratches over red. An up-facing face renders at ~1.05a + 60, so #8f4b3d lands at (210, 139, 124) against the plate (200, 130, 118); a colour probe of the render reads (211, 154, 135).

evidence: Measured on viewEvidence region-red (0.84) at #964f4e (a leg in shade on a WHITE matte) and region-rim at #bf5149. Authored for the harness key light rather than for the eye: a vertical face renders at ~0.8a + 22, so #dc4e3e lands at (198, 84, 72) against the plate lit apron (200, 80, 70).

Lifted from #b03a2e/#d04436 after a per-azimuth hole probe: a BACK-LIT face at azimuth 180 renders at ~0.55 of the painted luma, which put the rear legs at 60 -- on the silhouette gate backdrop luma of 58. At luma 120 authored they land at 66 and the flagged fraction of the 180 frame falls from 27 percent to 8.5, the remainder being genuine occlusion under the apron.
Textureless as DECLARED: one 256 px streak canvas bound after construction.
textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. It is also a correctness fix: with a texture set the generator forces color to white and roughness to 1 and reads both from the generated maps, discarding this measured albedo.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the small class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

materials.note: plastic only: 1 of 1; the worn seat is a vertex colour on it.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 560 of 800: an 18-segment shell lathe of 9 profile points, an 18-segment worn pan and four 8-segment full-height leg cylinders; the four lug pads are gone.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: One closed lathe for the whole shell, a thin lathe for the worn seat, and full-height flattened tapered cylinders for the legs whose tops are the stacking pads.
No InstancedMesh at one draw call. In a scene the HOST instances the stool.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
The material is declared textureless. One 256 px streak canvas after construction, 0.25 MB.

risks.mitigation: The plate centre-column scan is the stronger evidence for a concavity a generative reconstruction routinely fills; recorded rather than chased.

risks.description: The moulded apron handholds are not authored.

risks.description: White product matte: crop means run bright and shadowed at once.
risks.mitigation: Albedo taken from the rim crop and the leg crop together, then solved through the harness light response.
